title.zh: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】
title.en: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】

current_state.zh: WSJ/Protos 报道称 Tether 在 Bo Hines 任职白宫数字资产顾问期间通过 Bitfinex 和中介 Notorious 向 Hines 联合创立的 Nxum Capital 支付 630 万美元，首笔 249 万美元于 2025-05-11 转出；Hines 离开白宫后合同直接转给 Nxum；Nxum 否认 Hines 在白宫期间收到 Tether 相关资金；报道还提及相关超级 PAC 资金与 GENIUS Act 推进。
current_state.en: WSJ/Protos reported that Tether paid $6.3M to Nxum Capital, co-founded by Bo Hines, while Hines was a White House digital-assets adviser, with funds routed via Bitfinex and intermediary Notorious; the first $2.49M payment was sent on May 11, 2025; the contract was transferred directly to Nxum after Hines left the White House; Nxum denies Hines received Tether-derived funds during that period; the report also mentions related super PAC funding and GENIUS Act advocacy.

updates.title_zh: 【WSJ：Bo Hines 任职白宫期间，其持股公司通过 Tether 相关合作获 630 万美元】

updates.what_changed_zh: 《华尔街日报》报道称，Bo Hines持有咨询公司Nxum的股份，该公司在他担任白宫加密货币委员会执行主任、推动《GENIUS法案》期间，从与Tether相关的合作中收取了630万美元，其中包括试图将该法案的合规过渡期从18个月延长至36个月，之后他才成为Tether美国业务负责人。
updates.what_changed_en: The Wall Street Journal reported that Bo Hines held a stake in consulting firm Nxum, which collected $6.3M from Tether-related partnerships while he was executive director of the White House crypto council pushing the GENIUS Act, including a bid to extend its compliance transition from 18 to 36 months, before he became head of Tether's US operations.
